project.text: Kitchen renovation A folder of chats about one thing. Its chats follow its instructions, know of each other and can read each other, and keep what Perry remembers in them to the project. New chat Instructions How Perry works in this project: tone, format, audience, standing rules. A change reaches every chat in it with your next message, chats already going too. Saves as you type. Chats Each one is told what the others are about, and can search and read them. Chats outside the project cannot. No chats yet Start a chat here, or move one in from its menu. Start one Memory What Perry remembers in this project's chats. Only they see it; what Perry saves for every chat is on the Memory page. The kitchen tiles are the matte green ones from Porto. Long-term now Forget For example: Scripts for the Hackonomics YouTube channel: money explained for people in their twenties. Hook in the first line, short sentences, no jargon, 8 to 10 minutes read aloud. End every script with one question for the comments.

Name Personality Warm & chatty Warm and friendly, with a light touch of humour. Talks like a thoughtful friend, and checks in on how things are going. Calm & concise Calm, brief and to the point.
